text:
liam: Heads-up: PartnerY flagged ~1.8% entitlement mismatch across APAC customers. They believe usage windows are shifted by local timezone. Sample: partner_event_id=py-991, reported_window=2026-03-01T00:00:00+09:00, our-ingest-window=2026-02-28T15:00:00Z. Thoughts? cc @neha

neha: Likely our ingest normalizes windows to UTC start-of-day which can move daily windows for partners sending local-midnight windows. Need to confirm contract: do partners send local timezone windows or always UTC?

carmen: Partner contract says they send local tz windows for appliances. We accepted that historically but our rollups always bucket by UTC day for billing run. That creates off-by-one-day entitlements for APAC/EU customers.

liam: Not good. Quick mitigation: add a per-partner flag `use_partner_local_window` so ingest preserves partner window and billing rollup is done with partner window alignment for that partner.

infra-bot: Metric: marketplace.rollup.window_skew_count increased from 12 to 210 in last 24h for partner=PartnerY. Recent deploys: none.

neha: Implementation notes: store incoming `window` and `window_tz` in raw event.meta. During rollup, if partner.flag.use_partner_local_window==true, convert windows to canonical UTC range using partner tz and do not re-align to midnight UTC. Also add unit tests for daylight savings transitions.

carmen: Policy: for entitlement diffs caused by window skew, auto-apply credits for affected customers for last 30 days if delta > $25 or > 1% monthly bill. Notify partner with reconciliation summary and request a replay for corrected events beyond 30 days.

liam: Will add feature flag `preserve_partner_window_v1` -> canary 10% partners (start with PartnerY). Need dashboards: billing.window_skew.partnerY, rollup.discrepancy_rate.

partner-bot: PartnerY webhook health: 97.9% 200, 1.8% 4xx, replay endpoint: https://replay.partnery.example/replay.

neha: Edge-case: some partners omit timezone and assume server-to-server clocks match. For those, fallback to `reported_timestamp` timezone if present, else default to UTC and emit `meta.window_tz_inferred=true` so we can surface to partners.

liam: Okay owners: neha -> ingest change + tests, carmen -> partner policy + email template, ops -> dashboard and CANARY rollout (I'll coordinate). I'll open MET-5901 and assign.

carmen: Draft partner note: short explain of issue, credit policy, replay instructions, link to SDK snippet for setting window_tz. I'll post here when ready.

liam: Thanks. Small followup: add `recon:window_skew` tag to auto-credit transactions for tracking. Closing for now.
